reason: I'd want to know this camera is safe and not spying before I strap it on my kid or my dad. I'd spend weeks in the caregiver groups reading what real families say about it before I'd even consider the $249.
objection: A camera on someone who can't consent feels like surveillance. What about their dignity, and the privacy of the other people who get filmed when it's on?
would_change_my_mind: Caregiver groups and independent reviews showing it has actually found a wandering loved one quickly, plus a clear way to switch the camera off that keeps the GPS and SOS working.
